item.title: [All Time] New entry (#49): reddit-automation
item.description: New entry in All Time leaderboard. Rank: #49 Installs: 523571 Source: flowkit-labs/skills Description: Find Reddit threads where people are genuinely asking for what you offer, then draft short, genuinely helpful replies — disclosing your affiliation honestly and naming your product only when it truly answers the question. Two moves: discovery — scan the right subreddits for real needs (recommendation asks, expressed pain, competitor mentions) and rank the few threads where you can actually help; drafting — write from real experience, respect each community's self-promo rules, and keep a human in the loop to review and post. This markets on Reddit the honest way: contribute value, disclose who you are, never astroturf. Distilled from the playbook behind doany.ai's Reddit agent. Triggers on "find reddit opportunities", "reddit marketing", "reddit automation", "reply on reddit for my product", "reddit community engagement", "reddit lead gen", or any ask to turn Reddit threads into genuine, disclosed marketing replies.

item.title: [Hot] New entry (#1): connector-weatherapi
item.description: New entry in Hot leaderboard. Rank: #1 Installs: 8 Source: caffeinelabs/skills Description: MANDATORY recipe for every Caffeine build that reads weather data from a canister. The supported path is the `weatherapi-client` mops package (WeatherAPI.com) over outbound HTTPS, authenticated with a query-string API key. Hand-rolling `ic.http_request` calls to `api.weatherapi.com` is a FORBIDDEN anti-pattern — it bypasses the non-replicated-outcall safeguard (WeatherAPI bodies carry per-request clocks and fail consensus), the generated JSON decoding, and the API-key handling. Load this skill whenever the user, spec, or any prior task mentions weather, forecast, temperature, humidity, wind, rain, snow, conditions, sunrise, sunset, moon phase, astronomy, timezone, IP geolocation, marine or tide forecasts, or location autocomplete — and BEFORE writing any code that touches a weather endpoint.
